reuse.why: Fintegra is linked through a shared linkBankSyncAccount (extracted from the five copied provider functions), wrapped in the existing refuseIfAlreadyLinked guard, and its download goes through a generalised downloadBankSyncTransactions shared with Pluggy.ai and Akahu.

duplication.why: Removes the per-provider copies of the link flow and the duplicated Pluggy/Akahu download instead of adding a Fintegra copy; provider differences are expressed as getBankId/getFileId arguments.

placement.why: Link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, download logic in accounts/sync.ts, the base path in server-config.ts and the provider id and account type in types/models, as for the other providers.

scope.why: The request only adds a provider, but the change rewrites all existing link handlers and two download functions, mixing a large refactor (with small shifts such as Akahu's sync-event tables) into a feature change.

maintainability.why: One link routine and one download routine are much easier to own, though the two-layer createBankSyncLinker/linkBankSyncAccount factory with GoCardless calling the inner layer directly adds some indirection.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new handler is registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked and uses the shared link and download routines.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplication is removed rather than reshaped; the remaining per-provider pieces are only configuration.
